{{Quote|It was my mother who was an administrator in the education council.|Caline Metara, to Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Razor's Edge" />}}
'''Gerane Metara''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served as an [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] in the education council. She was the wife of [[Stavin Metara|Stavin]] and [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to [[Caline Metara|Caline]].<ref name="Razor's Edge" />
